segments.he: מַתְנִי׳ כֹּל שֶׁיֶּשְׁנוֹ בַּמִּקְרָא וּבַמִּשְׁנָה וּבְדֶרֶךְ אֶרֶץ – לֹא בִּמְהֵרָה הוּא חוֹטֵא, שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר: ״וְהַחוּט הַמְשֻׁלָּשׁ לֹא בִמְהֵרָה יִנָּתֵק״. וְכֹל שֶׁאֵינוֹ לֹא בַּמִּקְרָא וְלֹא בַּמִּשְׁנָה וְלֹא בְּדֶרֶךְ אֶרֶץ – אֵינוֹ מִן הַיִּישּׁוּב.
segments.en: «MISHNA:» «Anyone who is engaged in» the study of «Bible, and in» the study of «Mishna, and in» the «desired mode of behavior,» i.e., he performs labor and generally acts in an appropriate manner, «will not be quick to sin, as it is stated: “And a threefold cord is not quickly broken”» (Ecclesiastes 4:12). One who is involved in all three of these activities will not sin easily. «And anyone who does not engage in» the study of «Bible, nor» the study of «Mishna, nor» the «desired mode of behavior, is not part of society,» i.e., he is not considered a civilized person at all.

moves.cueHe: כל שישנו במקרא ובמשנה ובדרך ארץ
moves.summary: Engagement in the three protects from sin

edges.about: one engaged in Bible, Mishna and proper conduct will not quickly sin

positions.claim: one engaged in Bible, Mishna and derekh eretz will not quickly sin; one engaged in none is not part of society
